nuclei.description: YAML-driven vulnerability scanner with 9000+ community templates for modern threat detection
nuclei.usage:
nuclei -u https://target.com -t cves/ -silent
nuclei -l targets.txt -t exposures/ -severity critical
nuclei -target https://api.com -t technologies/
nuclei -u target.com -t misconfiguration/ -markdown-export report.md
